description: The portable subset's ? placeholders, rewritten by the Postgres drivers outside quoted literals and identifiers: pg numbers them $1..$n; psycopg writes %s and doubles every literal % (spec/schema/README.md, Storage).

cases.name: plain
cases.sql: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = ? AND c = ?
cases.pg: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = $1 AND c = $2
cases.psycopg: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = %s AND c = %s

cases.name: question mark in a string literal
like with a literal percent
cases.sql: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b LIKE '%x' AND c = ?
cases.pg: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b LIKE '%x' AND c = $1
cases.psycopg: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b LIKE '%%x' AND c = %s

cases.name: question mark in a quoted identifier
